# GPIO map - Raspberry Pi 5 40-pin header

Physical pin numbers are the header positions (pin 1 = square pad, notch end). BCM = GPIO number used by software (gpiozero, libgpiod, device tree).

## I2C address map

| Bus | Address | Ref | Function | Part | Fitted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| I2C0 | 0x48 | U8 | 4-ch 16-bit ADC | ADS1115 breakout | yes |
| I2C0 | 0x50 | U13 | HAT ID EEPROM | CAT24C32 (SOIC-8) | no (DNP) |
| I2C0 | 0x77 | U2 | Air quality T/RH/P/gas | BME680 breakout | yes |
| I2C1 | 0x28 | U7 | Differential pressure (airspeed) | MS4525DO-DS3AI001DP | yes |
| I2C1 | 0x69 | U1 | 9-axis IMU | ICM-20948 breakout (1.8 V VDDIO + level shifter) | yes |

The ICM-20948 magnetometer (AK09916) also appears at 0x0C on I2C1 when the IMU is put in I2C bypass mode (the bring-up script does this).
